description: This file defines the interface `ShippingService`, outlining the methods for managing shipping configurations, retrieving shipping options, packages, and shipment summaries within an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: ShippingService
classes.description: Interface defining contract for shipping-related operations such as retrieving available shipping options, configuring shipping modules, managing packages, and calculating shipment summaries.

methods.name: getSupportedCountries
methods.description: Returns a list of supported shipping countries configured by the merchant.

methods.name: setSupportedCountries
methods.description: Sets supported shipping countries for a merchant.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available shipping modules for the merchant.

methods.name: getShippingModulesConfigured
methods.description: Returns configured shipping modules for a given merchant.

methods.name: saveShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Saves configuration for a specific shipping quote module.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping configuration for a merchant.

methods.name: saveShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the shipping configuration for a merchant.

methods.name: removeShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a specific shipping quote module configuration.

methods.name: getPackagesDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed information about packages used for shipping quotes.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Retrieves shipping quotes for a set of products and delivery details.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration (overloaded version)
methods.description: Fetches specific shipping module configuration by code.

methods.name: getCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves custom configuration for a shipping module.

methods.name: saveCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves custom shipping configuration for a module.

methods.name: removeCustomShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes custom shipping quote module configuration.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Builds a shipping summary from selected options for order calculation.

methods.name: getShipToCountryList
methods.description: Returns the list of countries to which the store ships.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Determines if shipping should be proposed based on cart items.
